description.value: Phở Sunrise is a Vietnamese restaurant in South Surrey specializing in pho, located in a strip-mall unit at 15355 24 Avenue. It sits in a suburban commercial area near the 24 Avenue corridor and offers a sit-down dining experience focused on Vietnamese cuisine. A touring cyclist in the South Surrey area would find it a convenient stop for a restorative bowl of noodle soup.
